body.x: Hanho Industrial participated in the “2024 Future Innovation tech eXpo (FIX 2024)” held from October 23 to October 26 at Daegu EXCO.

Established in 1999 as a forging company, Hanho Industrial has expanded into machining and assembly. It specializes in automotive powertrain components for domestic and international markets and strives for global competitiveness.

Hanho Industrial has focused on relentless technological innovation, productivity maximization, and quality improvement despite its relatively short history. The company developed complex forging techniques such as precision tooth profile forging and Ring Rolling, reducing machining allowance and achieving component simplification and lightweight design, thus contributing to customer cost savings.

In 2022, Hanho Industrial achieved global recognition by exporting parts for Europe’s ZF 8HP transmission. At the 59th Trade Day of Korea, it was awarded the 30 Million Dollar Export Tower, marking its status as a global small but strong enterprise.
At FIX 2024, Hanho Industrial presented various transmission parts, including park gears, monoblocks, clutch bodies, gear blanks, carriers, flanges, hubs, shafts, and ring rolls.

body.x: FIX 2024 featured specialized exhibitions, conferences, and business programs focusing on mobility, robotics, AI, and startups. The Daegu International Future Auto & Mobility Expo 2024 at EXCO’s East Wing showcased trends in UAM, autonomous driving, batteries, components, and services. Meanwhile, the 2024 ICT Convergence Expo Korea, held in the West Wing, exhibited AI, big data, blockchain, ICT, and metaverse technologies. The 2024 Daegu Robot Expo displayed industrial robots, humanoid robots, and digital transformation solutions for the robotics industry. The “Startup Arena” was introduced to facilitate meetings between startups and experts from startup accelerators like Samsung C-Lab and Plug and Play.
